scope: Network.framework-only macOS daemon to Windows over en8; TCP/UDP inner traffic is encrypted AES-256-GCM UDP outer traffic. No BSD backend comparison.
windows_binary_revision: not independently verified during these runs
timing: TCP: 8 seconds measured + 1 second warmup. UDP: 5 + 1. Sequential samples on a normal desktop, not a controlled hardware limit.
cpu_accounting: Mac daemon cumulative process CPU delta / full command wall duration, including warmup; 1.0 means one core. RSS is sampled after each command, not a peak measurement. Windows daemon CPU was not measured.
